outcome.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly one cohort, named audit, with two tasks. T1: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved, and never steps the core (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts, oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T2: a composite selects the current revision per (unit_id, artifact_kind) stream before reading links, and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts, observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts).
The operator authorizes this audit path: the builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. The builder must not edit tracked repository files; ignored dependency materialization is permitted only if needed. If installation is needed, run bun install --frozen-lockfile and fail or report a known issue rather than changing bun.lock. The builder must not create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install --frozen-lockfile if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
The assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and brief short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: The audit is implementable with no blocking or operator-only decision. PR #793 currently resolves to head 100000b53ad4012df9c2074953ad2199adcc312b on the specified branch and base. T1 has direct authority and journal paths plus dedicated tests; T2 has direct selectors, snapshot-backed reads, and stage-isolation tests. Two wording corrections are recommended before planning: define current revision by the implemented unit-and-artifact stream, and clarify that conditional dependency installation may materialize ignored dependencies but may not change tracked files or the lockfile.

findings.description: The named audit target is concrete: gated PR status reports PR #793 open on head branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e at 100000b53ad4012df9c2074953ad2199adcc312b with base epic/grade-pray, and the same head ref is available locally. The builder can detach to the specified ref without any remote mutation.

T1 is directly assessable. oakridge-dbos/src/domain/analysis-link-declaration.ts:43-53 refuses a missing, non-tasks, or unapproved exact tasks revision and validates source findings; oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:738-784 locks the run, reads the approval for declaration.tasks_revision_id, and writes only the journal event and receipt; oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:791-804 binds approval-supplied links to request.event.target in the same transaction. Dedicated behavior tests cover exact approval and no workflow-state movement at oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:90-120 and approval/declaration atomicity at 222-276.

The T2 phrase current revision per unit is less precise than the committed model. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:114-135 keys each revision stream by [unit_id, artifact_kind], so two artifact kinds in one unit can both be current; observation/tests/composite.test.ts:102-118 explicitly tests that an artifact is its own stream within a unit. Clarifying this prevents an assessor from treating the intended two-key model as a failure of a strict one-current-revision-per-unit reading.

The second half of T2 is concrete and independently assessable. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:314-366 filters linked contributions by stage before selecting current items, produces one StageComposite per declared stage, and exposes no cross-stage aggregate; observation/tests/composite.test.ts:238-259 verifies implementation and integration answers remain separate. observation/src/storage/grading-record-store.ts:29-75 reads the run-scoped inputs under one tenant snapshot before invoking the pure selectors.

The builder instructions simultaneously prohibit editing files and conditionally require bun install. Installation necessarily materializes node_modules and may rewrite bun.lock unless frozen; the target .gitignore:1 shows node_modules is intentionally ignored and the target has a committed bun.lock. This is not an operator-choice blocker, but the allowed setup write and lockfile protection should be stated explicitly.

Assess that an analysis-link declaration is journaled only against its exact approved tasks revision and never itself steps the workflow core, using the named Oakridge authority files and separate test/output evidence.

Assess composite current-revision selection before link use and stage isolation in the named observation files; apply the proposed clarification that a stream is identified by unit_id plus artifact_kind.

Detach to the existing PR head, make no tracked source or lockfile changes, commits, pushes, PR mutations, merges, database resets, or deployments; run the observation test command once and publish actual build_result evidence followed by the existing PR artifact.

Assess the builder-recorded head_sha without changing files, provide at least one finding for each of T1 and T2 with path:start-end code evidence, cite test/output evidence separately, and report the builder run as test_evidence.

Verify T1 declaration approval, transactional journaling, and no core step behavior from source and tests.
Verify T2 current-revision-per-stream selection before link reading and stage isolation from source and tests.
Run bun run --filter observation test once and publish actual build_result, existing PR metadata, and assessment evidence.
out_of_scope: Editing tracked repository files or changing bun.lock.
Creating commits; pushing; opening, updating, or merging pull requests; rebasing or repairing branches.
Database reset, deployment, or feature implementation beyond auditing the committed PR.
Adding any operator choice or confirmation to the brief.

cohorts.scope: Perform an immutable audit of the two approved lineage behaviors on the existing PR head, verify them with one prescribed observation test run, and publish evidence-backed results without modifying the repository or pull request.
cohorts.title: Audit PR #793 lineage composites

decisions.text: Inspect detached commit 100000b53ad4012df9c2074953ad2199adcc312b from origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e and publish existing PR #793; do not edit tracked files or perform any git or PR mutation.
Judge T1 by whether the exact named tasks revision is approved before declaration journaling, whether the write is atomic, and whether declaration handling bypasses the workflow core step.
Judge T2 by whether currentness is selected independently for each (unit_id, artifact_kind) stream before links are read and whether composite results keep declared stages separate.
Run bun install --frozen-lockfile only if dependencies are needed, then run bun run --filter observation test exactly once and report its actual counts and output; inability to run is a known issue.

Produce at least three distinct analysis findings overall and at least one assessment finding per task, with commit-pinned path:start-end source citations plus separately labeled test or output evidence; report the builder run as test_evidence.

cohorts.description: One cohort is appropriate because T1 and T2 are two bounded checks in the same repository and PR, share a pinned commit and verification run, and together remain straightforward to review.

acceptance_criteria.text: Verify that an analysis-link declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved, that declaration journaling is atomic, and that the declaration never steps the workflow core.
Verify that composite grading selects the current revision independently for each (unit_id, artifact_kind) stream before reading links and keeps declared stages isolated.

body.summary: Audit the committed head of existing PR #793 without repository changes, covering exact-revision declaration authority and composite stream/stage semantics with source citations and one actual observation test run.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one cohort named audit contains T1 and T2 and targets repository oakridge.
The builder checks out the specified PR head detached, makes no tracked changes, and publishes build_result with the inspected head SHA and actual test output/counts.
The builder publishes existing PR #793 on branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e without creating or updating a PR.
Analysis contains at least three distinct findings, and assessment contains at least one finding for each of T1 and T2.
Every assessment finding cites source as path:start-end at the pinned commit and cites test or output evidence separately; the builder test run is reported as test_evidence.
